needsBespoke.why: K'Sante's damage output is governed by feedback loops the primitive list cannot express as independent pieces: (1) R's All Out simultaneously slashes K'Sante's own base armor/MR and imposes a health ceiling while ALSO empowering Q/W's damage (which itself scales off K'Sante's own bonus armor/MR) and P's mark bonus (which scales off K'Sante's own bonus armor/MR) — so the caster's own stat state must be tracked and re-derived mid-fight rather than treated as a flat self-buff; (2) P's All Out bonus explicitly amplifies an existing damage instance rather than adding a new one, and only ever applies to the first target of a multi-target hit, which is a multiplicative-not-additive rule not covered by onhit-rider/stat-conversion alone; (3) R's damage is genuinely conditional on unmodeled terrain geometry, producing either one or two separate physical damage instances of different magnitude; (4) Q's live cooldown is itself a function of the build's bonus resistances (a dynamic, resistance-driven cooldown-reduction formula, not a fixed per-rank cooldown), which interacts with mana budget and attack-reset timing all at once.
